mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate over three months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE rises for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals weakening demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS declines for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening regime that raises discount rates, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline after FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
